name: Placement Portal
brief: Build a web portal for the college Training and Placement Office (TPO). Students maintain profiles and resumes, companies post drives and jobs, students apply, and the TPO tracks applications, shortlists and offers with an admin dashboard and reports. Email notifications for new drives and status changes. Past placement records from spreadsheets must be migrated. Team of eight; target go-live by mid-January for the placement season, about eleven weeks.

tasks.name: Define functional specs and user stories
Create project plan and sprint schedule
UI/UX wireframes for company portal and admin dashboard
Set up CI/CD pipeline and dev environment
Build student profile and resume module

risks.title: Late addition of profile fields expands scope
risks.cause: Stakeholders request extra data fields for student profiles after functional specs are signed
risks.event: The project scope expands beyond the agreed baseline
risks.effect: Additional UI design and database changes delay development
risks.response: Conduct a scope change review meeting and update specs with sign‑off before any design work begins

risks.title: Auth service integration with email provider fails
risks.cause: Authentication module is built to use SMTP credentials that are later changed by the email provider
risks.effect: Delay in implementing email notifications and user login
risks.response: Use a sandbox email account for early testing and validate provider settings during T10 development

risks.title: Key developer unavailable during exam period
risks.cause: One of the two developers is a final‑year student with mandatory exams
risks.event: Developer cannot work on assigned tasks for two weeks
risks.effect: Development of profile, drive posting, and application workflow slips
risks.response: Cross‑train the second developer on these modules and adjust sprint backlog to reassign work

risks.title: College firewall blocks API endpoints
risks.cause: Network security team requires new firewall rules for external API traffic
risks.event: CI/CD pipeline cannot reach the staging environment
risks.response: Submit firewall rule request in week 1 and obtain provisional exception for test environment

risks.title: Limited test data causes integration bugs
risks.cause: Test data set only covers happy path scenarios
risks.event: Integration testing uncovers failures in edge cases
risks.effect: Additional bug fixing and retesting extend testing phase
risks.response: Create comprehensive test data covering edge cases before T15 starts

risks.title: Inconsistent spreadsheet formats break migration
risks.cause: Historical placement records are stored in varied spreadsheet templates
risks.event: Automated migration scripts raise parsing errors
risks.effect: Data migration is delayed and requires manual cleanup
risks.response: Standardize source files and build validation scripts before migration begins

risks.title: Stakeholder interview delays push schedule
risks.cause: Key TPO staff are unavailable for interviews in the first week
risks.event: Requirements gathering finishes later than planned
risks.effect: Functional specs and project plan are delayed, impacting design start
risks.response: Schedule backup interview slots and use questionnaires to gather preliminary info

risks.title: Designer workload overload delays wireframes
risks.cause: Designer assigned to both student and company portal concurrently
risks.event: Wireframe delivery exceeds allocated 4 days each
risks.effect: Development tasks that depend on UI designs start late
risks.response: Prioritize student portal wireframes first and consider hiring a freelance UI helper

risks.title: Additional reporting metrics added late
risks.cause: TPO requests new KPI dashboards after initial specs
risks.event: Design and API contracts need extra fields
risks.effect: Dashboard development and testing are extended
risks.response: Lock reporting requirements in the functional specs sign‑off and treat any new metric as a change request

risks.title: Email provider outage during notification rollout
risks.cause: Third‑party email service experiences downtime during go‑live week
risks.effect: Students miss drive announcements, leading to reputational impact
risks.response: Implement retry logic and inform users to check portal for updates during provider outage
